newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Spiegel estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Spiegel estimates cut.

text.p: - Barrington Research Associates Inc said it cut its earnings estimates for Spiegel Inc, citing weakness in sales.
- Analyst Debra O'Shea dropped her estimate for the third quarter to a loss of $0.16 a share from a loss of $0.10.

- O'Shea said she also trimmed her fourth quarter earnings estimate to $0.32 a share from $0.38, and her 1996 full-year estimate to break even from a profit of $0.12 a share. For 1997, she cut her earnings estimate to $0.30 a share from $0.38.
- August sales were worse than expected, O'Shea said. She said she expects to see improvement during September, but negative year-on-year comparisons are likely.
- Barrington, however, reiterated its long-term buy rating on the stock, recommending accumulation by patient investors.
